# Purpose

This script analyzes sales data.

# Inputs

Sales values:

- 120
- 250
- 180
- 300
- 275

# Code Example

```r
sales <- c(120,250,180,300,275)
sum(sales)
```

# Outputs

- Total sales
- Average sales
